text: This iceberg is wrong. It says the internet has seven or eight levels, and the bottom ones are too dangerous to name.
Level one: the surface web. Everything a search engine can find.
Level two: the deep web. Your inbox. Your bank. Hidden because it's behind a login, not because it's sinister.
Level three: the dark web. Software that bounces you through at least three computers, so nobody can tell who's talking to whom. It was invented by the U.S. Navy.
Below that, the picture says: Marianas Web. The Fog. The Primarch System.
None of them exist. They were made up on a forum.
But there is something under the dark web. It's real, it's been photographed — and it goes to the bottom of the sea.
Every real level, down to the sea floor, is linked right here.
